body.name: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY}}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY}}=\{(P_n)_{n\ge1}\in\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}:\mathsf A_{\mathrm{rem}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{rem}})\}\).  Equivalently, every finite slice obeys \(\Delta_{\mathrm{CY},n}(K)\sqrt{\log(2K)}\le\varepsilon_n^{\mathrm{rem}}\) for the one fixed vanishing envelope \(\varepsilon^{\mathrm{rem}}\).  This is the band-valid event-transfer subclass, not the full published Choi--Yuan class.
